chat_with_video.title: Chat about a YouTube video
chat_with_video.description: Ask the bump-1.0 model a free-form question about a public YouTube video and get a generated answer (a summary when no prompt is given). Use this for open questions; for structured creator outputs prefer generate_timestamps, generate_titles, generate_description, generate_hashtags or generate_takeaways.

url.description: Full URL of the public YouTube video to process, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID. Private or age-restricted videos cannot be read.

model.description: Bumpups model that processes the video. bump-1.0 is the only published model.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the output is written in (en, hi, es, pt, ru, de, fr, ja, ko, ar). Provider default: en.

prompt.description: Question or instruction about the video, up to 500 characters. Use "summary" (the default) for a general summary of the video.

output_format.description: Format of the generated answer: plain text or markdown. Provider default: text.

output.description: The model's answer for the video, together with the request echo (url, model, language, output format) and the video metadata Bumpups returns.

generate_timestamps.title: Generate video timestamps
generate_timestamps.description: Generate chapter-style timestamps (time offset plus a label for each section) for a public YouTube video from its content, ready to paste into a video description. Use chat_with_video instead for questions about what happens at a specific point.

url.description: Full URL of the public YouTube video to process, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID. Private or age-restricted videos cannot be read.

model.description: Bumpups model that processes the video. bump-1.0 is the only published model.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the output is written in (en, hi, es, pt, ru, de, fr, ja, ko, ar). Provider default: en.

timestamps_style.description: Preferred length of each timestamp label: long (descriptive) or short (a few words). Provider default: long.

output.description: The generated list of timestamps for the video, with the request echo and video metadata Bumpups returns.

generate_titles.title: Generate creator titles
generate_titles.description: Generate several engaging, click-worthy title suggestions for a public YouTube video based on what the video actually covers. Use generate_description for the description text and generate_hashtags for tags.

url.description: Full URL of the public YouTube video to process, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID. Private or age-restricted videos cannot be read.

model.description: Bumpups model that processes the video. bump-1.0 is the only published model.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the output is written in (en, hi, es, pt, ru, de, fr, ja, ko, ar). Provider default: en.

output.description: The suggested titles for the video, with the request echo and video metadata Bumpups returns.

generate_description.title: Generate creator description
generate_description.description: Generate a compelling, SEO-friendly description for a public YouTube video based on its content. Pair with generate_timestamps to add chapters, or use generate_takeaways for a bullet summary instead of prose.

url.description: Full URL of the public YouTube video to process, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID. Private or age-restricted videos cannot be read.

model.description: Bumpups model that processes the video. bump-1.0 is the only published model.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the output is written in (en, hi, es, pt, ru, de, fr, ja, ko, ar). Provider default: en.

output.description: The generated description text for the video, with the request echo and video metadata Bumpups returns.

generate_hashtags.title: Generate creator hashtags
generate_hashtags.description: Generate relevant hashtags, or plain keywords, for a public YouTube video based on its content, for discovery and SEO. Use generate_titles for title ideas and generate_takeaways for key points.

url.description: Full URL of the public YouTube video to process, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID. Private or age-restricted videos cannot be read.

model.description: Bumpups model that processes the video. bump-1.0 is the only published model.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the output is written in (en, hi, es, pt, ru, de, fr, ja, ko, ar). Provider default: en.

output_format.description: Whether to return #hashtags or plain keywords (for tags fields and SEO). Provider default: hashtags.

output.description: The generated hashtags or keywords for the video, with the request echo and video metadata Bumpups returns.

generate_takeaways.title: Generate creator takeaways
generate_takeaways.description: Generate the key takeaways of a public YouTube video as a short list of points, optionally decorated with emojis. Use chat_with_video for a free-form summary or a specific question, and generate_description for a prose description.

url.description: Full URL of the public YouTube video to process, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID. Private or age-restricted videos cannot be read.

model.description: Bumpups model that processes the video. bump-1.0 is the only published model.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the output is written in (en, hi, es, pt, ru, de, fr, ja, ko, ar). Provider default: en.

emojis_enabled.description: Whether to prefix the generated takeaways with emojis. Provider default: false.

output.description: The generated key takeaways for the video, with the request echo and video metadata Bumpups returns.
